summary: Verified PulseFitness.ai 'Pulse Fitness Ltd' locked default supplier feature end-to-end. Backend pytest suite (7/7 passed) covers: Pro/Full GET returns locked default pinned first with can_add_suppliers=true; PUT and DELETE on default → 403; Pro POST create + cleanup succeeds; dispatch-readiness returns coherent counts (ready+blocked==total, no_supplier<=ready); Lite GET returns only the locked default with can_add_suppliers=false; Lite POST → 403. Frontend Playwright verification against production URL: LITE (lite.suptest@pulsedemo.test → /pulse → user menu → Account Settings → Suppliers) shows exactly one row 'Pulse Fitness Ltd' with DEFAULT badge + lock icon, NO edit/delete buttons, and NO 'Add supplier' button. PRO (owner@isodemo.com → /dashboard → Account Settings → Suppliers) shows the locked default row (DEFAULT badge + lock, no edit/delete), the 'Add supplier' button is visible and opens the Add supplier modal correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: suppliers.py POST endpoint currently allows any authenticated user (owner/manager check not enforced on POST — only on send-welcome / assign-equipment). Consider gating POST/PUT/DELETE consistently through _require_owner_or_manager for defense in depth, though role-based UI hiding is already in place.
